candidates.description: This feature vector represents common German given names and cultural-linguistic roots.
These tokens are French prepositions indicating spatial, temporal, or logical relations.
This feature vector represents political, ideological, and socio-economic systems and philosophies.
This feature vector represents French modal and auxiliary verbs used to express necessity, ability, or state of being.
This feature vector represents abstract ideas, philosophical concepts, and theoretical doctrines.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens starting with the prefix "ex-".
This vector represents common French adverbial modifiers of time, degree, and logical connection.
These tokens are characterized by the presence of the phonetic sequence "ut" across various words and morphologic variations.
This vector represents French-derived or British English-spelled words and morphological roots involving organization and utilization.
These tokens share the morphological root or suffix "-ist-" / "-ism" associated with nouns and philosophical or political concepts.
